class.name: SVG2D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup in a 2D scene.
class.description: SVG2D rasterizes SVG markup at the resolution it occupies in the viewport. It updates at resolution boundaries and reuses the generated texture while the drawing area remains in the same resolution level.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture rasterized from [member src] at [member size].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], redraws the SVG at a higher texture resolution when it grows in the viewport. The current power-of-two level is reused to avoid redrawing during every frame of a zoom. Each texture axis is limited to 4096 pixels.

The SVG display size in local coordinates. Set both components above zero to override the SVG document size. [code]Vector2.ZERO[/code] uses the document size. When [member adaptive] is enabled, the internal texture can be larger to keep the result sharp.
The complete SVG markup to render. Load an SVG file as text and assign its contents here.
